integrity: The characteristic polynomial and Routh determinant are derived directly from the printed vector field. Exact arithmetic checks the showcased parameter point; numerical roots are auxiliary. Search limitations are stated explicitly.
scientific_limitations: Local integer-order equilibrium classification only; no claim about the equilibrium line, global attractors, fractional-order stability, or nonlinear bifurcation type at the imaginary-pair boundary \(b=a\).
title: A sharp stability boundary for the isolated equilibria of a line-equilibrium chaotic flow
